result: Backup, frozen deployment, approved offline settings and cold restart passed. Final isolation check found a rewritten shared Start Menu shortcut and a notification activation path pointing to the new executable without its isolated-profile argument.

acceptedScope.uiSettingsMethod: User explicitly approved replacing I4 UI settings actions with a backed-up offline four-boolean edit and cold-start persistence check.

blocker.observedChange: Target and working directory changed from retained old installation to the new candidate; arguments were empty, so the isolated profile was not carried.
blocker.notificationRegistry: The application ToastActivatorCLSID LocalServer32 default value currently points to the new candidate. No before-install registry snapshot exists.
blocker.sourceBasedDiagnosis: The frozen app checks Notification.isSupported in attentionAvailable. Electron's notification presenter initialization can register its COM activator and asynchronously ensure a product-name Start Menu shortcut plus LocalServer32. This path is separate from the app's guarded manual shortcut creation.
blocker.confidence: Observed shortcut/registry bindings are direct local evidence; the trigger chain is a static diagnosis from frozen app modules and matching declared Electron 44.4.5 source, not a captured runtime trace.

containment.notificationRegistryCorrection: Prepared for explicit user confirmation; the retained old app and original shortcut share the same notification identities. Not claimed as historical registry restoration.
containment.oldShortcutHistoryQualification: One original Start Menu shortcut was rewritten and later restored exactly. Current baseline matches do not mean all original shortcuts stayed unchanged throughout the attempt.
containment.notificationCorrectionScopeLimit: The pending proposal changes one LocalServer32 default value only; it does not restore an unknown historical registry snapshot, all notification registration fields, or prove runtime COM activation.

auditIssues.resolution: Target stayed unchanged; preserved failure; used an explicit new backup pathname, verified the replacement backup and restored link.

auditIssues.resolution: Reconnection did not recover input; user approved offline I4 replacement. No UI-click success claimed.
